messages:
Jordan P: Urgent help please  my surgeon says the insurer has my name spelled differently than on my member record and they're holding the pre-auth for my knee scope until it matches. Surgery is tomorrow morning. Is there a same-day fix? :grimacing:

Kim (People Ops): Oof. We can do two things fast: 1) issue a company-signed temporary proof of coverage that lists your member ID and DOB, 2) submit an expedited name correction request to the carrier. Do you have the EOB or member ID handy?

Jordan P: Member ID: M555210987, insurer shows "Jordan Phillips" but my legal is "Jordan Patel-Phillips". I have a scanned marriage certificate and a screenshot of the carrier portal showing the mismatch.

Noah - Benefits: Okay. Carrier policy: physical card/name-change takes several days. But carrier will accept a signed employer letter + proof of ID for clinics to proceed with pre-auth. We can issue that letter within 1 hour if you email docs to benefits@redwood.com with subject EXACT: "URGENT PREAUTH - Jordan P". Include member ID, DOB, appointment date/time, and attach the document scans.

Jordan P: Email sent with attachments (marriage_certificate.pdf + portal_screenshot.png) and appointment details: Orthopedics Center, 2026-05-02 08:00.

BenefitsBot:  Ticket created: #BEN-4999  "URGENT: pre-auth hold due to name mismatch". Assigned to Noah. Target response: same day. Please confirm attachments uploaded to ticket.

Noah - Benefits: Confirmed. I'm generating the temporary coverage & identity confirmation letter now. Also calling the carrier's provider relations to flag the pre-auth number can be processed using the member ID despite name variation. If provider still needs a carrier pre-auth number, ask them to accept the employer letter and provide their claim/preauth contact so we can push.

Clinic Billing: We're seeing this on our side. The pre-auth system is strict about exact name/TIN match. If you can get a signed employer letter + member ID, we can attach that to the pre-auth request and ask auth team to proceed pending carrier correction. Please deliver the PDF to billing@ortho-center.com and confirm the authorization form has the employer letter attached.

Kim (People Ops): We uploaded the signed PDF to the ticket and emailed Clinic Billing on your behalf. PDF filename: "Redwood_TEMP_Coverage_JordanP_2026-05-02.pdf". Noah also called provider relations and left a note referencing pre-auth case PA-7784 (carrier internal ref).

Jordan P: Got the PDF in my inbox and forwarded to the clinic. They said they'll re-submit the pre-auth with the letter and tentatively hold the slot. Huge relief, thank you!! :pray:
